users.bio: Backend engineer. Coffee before code, always.
Frontend dev. CSS enthusiast, semicolon skeptic.
Product designer. Sketching on napkins since 2015.
DevOps. If it is not automated, it is broken.
Data engineer. Pipelines by day, board games by night.
Mobile dev. iOS mostly, Android when forced.
QA lead. I break things so users do not have to.
Database admin. Normalize first, ask questions later.
Open source maintainer. PRs welcome, issues tolerated.
Junior dev. Still figuring out git rebase.

tweets.content: Finally got the build green after three days of chasing a flaky test.
Hot take: tabs vs spaces matters less than consistent formatting.
Spent the morning refactoring and the diff is somehow bigger than the feature.
Code review comment of the day: "why not just use a map?"
Deployed on a Friday. Living dangerously.
The bug was a missing await. It is always a missing await.
Pair programming session turned into a two-hour design discussion. Worth it.
Wrote a test first for once. Felt illegal.
Migrated a table with zero downtime. Small wins.
Someone asked me to explain CORS again. Send help.
New keyboard arrived. Productivity up 0%, satisfaction up 100%.
Debugging is just being the detective in a crime movie where you are also the murderer.
Standup ran long because everyone had opinions about naming a variable.
Read the docs. Docs were wrong. Filed an issue.
Three cups of coffee and a working regex. Good day.
Rewrote it in half the lines. Also half the readability. Reverting.
The staging environment is closer to production than production is.
Learned a new keyboard shortcut and now I feel unstoppable.
Merge conflicts on a Monday morning set the tone for the week.
Shipped a tiny fix that took four hours to track down.
Turns out the cache was never the problem. It never is.
Whiteboard session settled the architecture debate in ten minutes.
Wrote documentation nobody will read until it saves someone a week.
Upgraded a dependency and nothing broke. Suspicious.
The demo gods were merciful today.
Refactored the tests before the code. New personal best.
Found a decade-old TODO comment. Left it there for tradition.
Pushed a hotfix straight from the couch. Remote work perks.
Explained recursion by explaining recursion.
The linter caught a real bug for once. Respect.
Long weekend planned: sleep, hiking, and absolutely no laptops.
Tried a new coffee shop near the office. The wifi was the real highlight.
Board game night got competitive fast. No regrets.
Finally organized my desk. Found three chargers I forgot I owned.
Weekend project: building a mechanical keyboard from scratch.
Rewatched an old favorite movie. Still holds up.
Trying to get back into running. Day one was humbling.
Cooked something new tonight and it actually worked out.
Library trip turned into an accidental four-book haul.
Sunday plan: nothing, and I am looking forward to it.
